transport: GitHub mirrored handoff, not direct in-chat cross-repo mutation
purpose: Keep the Asset Mapper standalone in Havenwild while producing clean, portable contracts for Ember to ingest into the eventual generic editor/tooling monorepo.
rules: Havenwild remains the authoritative development/proof project for this mapper lane right now.
Havenwild internal PCC remains the patch/gate authority for Havenwild patches.
Ember receives mirrored contracts, docs, and later extracted generic modules from GitHub after Havenwild commits are green.
Do not prematurely move the standalone mapper out of Havenwild until the Terrain Lane and Asset Mapping Workspace are usable.
Genericizable pieces must be named and documented so they can become Ember editor modules later.
genericExtractionCandidates: Forge/Ember GUI tokens and dock panels
Asset sheet stack and source sheet profiles
